questions: When the board is fully visible, does it hold exactly three pens arranged in a single row?
Are all three pens aligned identically, all pointing the same way, including any pen near the left or right frame edge as it enters or exits?
Do all three pens share identical barrel and cap colors, with no mismatch?
Is every pen fully capped with no exposed writing tip, and are all three pens equal in length?
Does the board advance steadily from left to right at EVERY moment, never halting, freezing, or pausing even briefly (1-3 seconds) at any point in the video?
Do all pens stay fixed in their positions on the board, with no pen shifting, sliding, or moving on its own relative to the board mid-clip?

question_answers.evidence: From 00:08 to 00:12, the board is fully visible and clearly holds exactly three pens arranged in a row.
All three pens are oriented with the cap end pointing towards the bottom of the frame and the barrel pointing up; they are perfectly aligned.
All three pens have identical translucent barrels and black caps/ends; there is no color mismatch.
Every pen appears fully capped with no exposed tips, and all three appear to be the same length.
The board moves continuously and smoothly from left to right throughout the entire clip without stopping or reversing.
The pens remain fixed in their slots on the board and do not shift or slide relative to the board during movement.

parsed.reason: The board carries exactly three identical, capped pens aligned in the same direction, and moves smoothly from left to right without interruption.

description: Three identical pens moving left to right on the board, smooth continuous motion.
